system.summary: Figures and invented signs with dividers, oblique hairlines, raised o and dot groups (nulls or marks); a partial homophonic key from one glossed 17-sign name group (Brackx). Whether syllable or word codes occur is not established.
system.sibling_key: Colbert 427 f. 325r (23 Apr 1585) and its two glossed name groups on ff. 325v, 326r; fr. 16026 f. 120, f. 126, p. 129 deciphered at the time but not digitised

prior_solution.where: Contemporary decipherments of the 1585 siblings (Colbert 427 f. 325 margin; fr. 16026 f. 120, f. 126, p. 129); none known for f. 99 or the undeciphered part of pp. 130-130bis (Rott 1882). Not on DECODE or Cryptoole.

conditions.human_role: Contributed: Michael Brackx found the items in Rott, transcribed f. 325r and ran the alignment tests with Claude Code (Opus 5.5); the project owner set up Claude Code and posed the problem.
tools: Brackx's sliding and gapped-alignment scripts (issue #82; not in the repository)

solution.what: Brackx (issue #82): Rott, Inventaire sommaire I (1882) pp. 193-197, Fleury's whole embassy 1582-86: only fr. 16026 f. 99 and part of pp. 130-130bis marked non déchiffré; deciphered siblings fr. 16026 f. 120, f. 126, p. 129 and Colbert 427 f. 325.
Colbert 427 on Gallica (btv1b10033949q; views run 19-20 ahead of folios); fr. 16026 not digitised (Biblissima) and consultation by authorisation (BnF record).
Brackx transcribed the f. 325r cipher block and the 18-line margin decipherment from the 2000-px Gallica image, and the two glossed name groups on ff. 325v and 326r.
f. 325v name group: 17 signs against 'messieurs de surich', one sign per letter with consistent repeats; partial homophonic key of 13 values (e, s, i, u, r, m, d, c, h).
Rigid slide of the margin text over the 244 main-block tokens with the partial key: best -2/-3 against shuffled-key medians -3 (95th percentile 0/-1): no better than chance.
Frequencies on the first transcription support the key: C+Z (e) 14% of the block, 9 (r) 6%, 6 (u) 5%, M (i) 5%; C the commonest sign.
Brackx re-read f. 325r at 7654 x 5802 px (BnF IIIF max): about ten signs corrected, both '=' in l. 5 are C (e).

Gapped alignment of the corrected block with the margin, anchored on the partial key: raised o, /// and dot groups fall as nulls; proposed multi-letter codes unstable across runs. Full key: 2 of 12 random French passages align as well; firm values only: block beats 47 of 50 random passages (p ~ 0.06). Inconclusive without a second crib.
Target folder opened from the issue material (transcription, margin, name groups, legend). Gallica search for fr. 17020 blocked by the bot check.

outcome.method_basis: A partial homophonic key from one glossed 17-sign name group fits French by frequency and a gapped alignment (p ~ 0.06), but does not yet pin the alignment of the f. 325r block with its margin; the undeciphered letters in fr. 16026 are not digitised.
